arguments.VQC_code:
n_qubits = 10
input_length = 9
q_out = 18
n_layers = 3
dev = qml.device("default.qubit", wires=n_qubits)

@qml.qnode(dev, interface="torch")
def circuit(inputs, weights):
    for i in range(min(input_length, n_qubits-1)):
        qml.RX(inputs[i], wires=i)
        qml.RY(inputs[i], wires=i)
    qml.RX(0.5, wires=n_qubits-1)
    qml.RY(0.5, wires=n_qubits-1)
    
    for l in range(n_layers):
        for i in range(n_qubits):
            qml.Rot(weights[l, i, 0], weights[l, i, 1], weights[l, i, 2], wires=i)
        for i in range(n_qubits):
            qml.CNOT(wires=[i, (i + 1) % n_qubits])
            qml.CNOT(wires=[(i + 1) % n_qubits, i])
            qml.SWAP(wires=[i, (i + 1) % n_qubits])
            qml.CZ(wires=[i, (i + 1) % n_qubits])
        for i in range(min(input_length, n_qubits-1)):
            qml.RX(inputs[i], wires=i)
            qml.RY(inputs[i], wires=i)
        qml.RX(0.5, wires=n_qubits-1)
        qml.RY(0.5, wires=n_qubits-1)
    
    obs = [qml.PauliZ(i) for i in range(n_qubits)]
    return [qml.expval(o) for o in obs * ((q_out + n_qubits - 1) // n_qubits)][:q_out]
